book.name: IBELIU
book.title: ME IBELIU ꞌIDI LETA YESU MANUNA

content: Yesu Mosese ꞌiloetana sinena
Gosegwao, ꞌomi be ꞌaboꞌagu Yaubada ꞌiesinuweda ꞌina sena manuna, ꞌilobwenena be Yesu tanuwaꞌiꞌisi, manuna tauna ꞌida tapwalolo ꞌana tosimana be wate ꞌida totaliya sinabwana,
ga ꞌietaetapewa ꞌina guinuwa nina Yaubada ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena manuna, nadigega lowa Mosese ꞌietaetapewaꞌesa Yaubada ꞌina anuwaya.

ꞌEnega Yesu tupu sinabwana ꞌilobena, ta Mosese ꞌana tupu tupwana namo tuga, ꞌatuwa nadigega anuwa boboꞌana nigeya tauna tupu sinabwana ꞌida lobena saꞌi, ta ꞌana toꞌabi esi. Ta Mosese nadigega anuwa, ta Yesu toꞌabi.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, anuwa ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌadi toꞌabi simiyami, ta yage maiboꞌadi ꞌadi toguinuwa Yaubada.
Mosese Yaubada ꞌina anuwaya ꞌietapewa toguinuwa ꞌatuwa, ga Yaubada ꞌina onao yage nidi maꞌetamo sida apwesa manudi ꞌisimana apwesedi.
Ta Keliso Yaubada ꞌina anuwaya ꞌietapewa nigeya toguinuwa ꞌatuwa ta esi tauna natu ꞌaiꞌailina. ꞌAboꞌada Yaubada ꞌina anuwa nina tuga, ꞌeguma taemisa ataya ma ida ꞌatepatu be ma ida gwausowala.
Yaubada ꞌana bodao ꞌetamo taeyawaiꞌata
ꞌEnega Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌieoneda, ꞌigwae, “Batuwa, ꞌeguma ꞌenana wanono,
geyaꞌabo saꞌi wadebadeba paꞌala nadigega tubumiyao lowaenei mitawaya sitoogu, ta ꞌigu loina siguitoyasena.

Manuna yakwala poti soladiya ꞌigu guinuwa waiwaidi yaudi siꞌitedi, ta tubumiyao nidi ꞌidi lomugi be ꞌidi ꞌeetete ꞌediyega sitoogu ga manudi yaloꞌameꞌame, ga yagwae, ‘Tuta maiboꞌana taudi ꞌidi nuwenuwega sitautauya gesi, manuna ꞌigu ꞌeda nigeya simwalamwalatoni.’
ꞌEnega yagamwasowaledi ga yabaꞌedi, yagwae, ‘Geyaꞌabo wate ꞌigu ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌena silugulugu.’ ”
Gosegwao, waꞌitaꞌiꞌisimi be geyaꞌabo wadebadeba paꞌala nai waneeneta ꞌabona nai Yaubada mayawasina wamiyasine.
Ta gete tuga taumimo waelemalema ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya, be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo bubuna toꞌumalina ꞌena wakwanikwani be Yaubada ꞌenana waloguitoyase.
ꞌAboꞌada lowa ꞌida emisa Keliso ꞌena tasaꞌuna, ta ꞌabo ꞌida emisa nina tagiyaiꞌiꞌisi be ꞌana laba tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa ꞌenaya, Keliso maꞌedai taegwausowala leleleya.
Nadigega Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌigwae, “Batuwa ꞌabo ꞌina ona wanono, geyaꞌabo wadebadeba paꞌala nadigega tubumiyao lowaenei ꞌigu loina siguitoyasena.”
Yaisigedi Yaubada ꞌina ona sinononaya ta siguitoyasena? Taudi Mosese Itipita ꞌenega ꞌianuganedi ga siapwesama, aga?
Ta wate taudi yakwala poti soladiya ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalidi manudi Yaubada ꞌiloꞌameꞌame, ꞌenega totoꞌumalina nidi mitawaya simwawasa.
Manuna taudi ꞌina ona nigeya simulimuliye, ꞌenega ꞌiona upaupaedi ga ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wate ꞌigu ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌena silugulugu.”
ꞌEnega tamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene taudi nigeya silugulugu, manuna nigeya siemiemisa.
